value: All three approaches identified AUD-related deficits in total tissue and total gray matter, but only Ceres identified a total white matter volume deficit.

Regional analysis of cerebellar gray matter revealed FDR-corrected volume deficits in the AUD group relative to the control group as follows: Ceres lobules I-IV and I-V, Crus I, VIIIB, and IX; SUIT lobules I-IV, VIIIB, and IX; and Hopkins lobules I-V, Crus II, and IX
